## bb75d495c809

**Reproduced API-contract defect; no semantic distribution issue found in the
bounded probe.** `generate(1, 0, bogus=1)` silently returns a normal 10x10 grid,
and `difficulty="extreme"` is silently treated as the medium/default band. An
override typo or unsupported band therefore produces plausible but unintended
training data instead of failing loudly. The cheapest repair is an explicit
unknown-key check against `AXES` plus validation of the three supported band
names before constructing `gen_ctx`.

I separately checked the task semantics rather than inferring a broader failure
from that API issue. All four canonical inputs passed `self_check` with their
expected size histograms. Across 384 ordinary generated inputs, none failed
`self_check`, every input contained components of sizes 1, 2, and 3, all declared
canvas and wall-color variants appeared, and both diagonal-contact branches
appeared. Thirty-two seeds each of exact `big_pockets=True`,
`diagonal_contact=False`, and `diagonal_contact=True` probes realized the
requested branch and pocket count without a mismatch. I did not reproduce a
component-size-label shortcut within this bounded audit.

Evidence: `checks/audit-probes.json` and `checks/audit-probes.log`. The unknown
key/difficulty finding is verified; the statement that no semantic issue was
found is limited to the enumerated canonical, ordinary, and exact-override
probes—not a proof that the generator is shortcut-free.

triage.reason: Brief-reviewed under October 3 lightweight policy; preserve reported evidence and findings. Shared-tool requests consolidated separately. No maintainer battery/test/private-solve rerun or automatic training admission.
